title: plugin-grid + plugin-list + types: follow the object-grid `description` / `emptyState` / `keyboardNavigation` rows (objectstack#20694) once released — list them in `GRID_QUERY_INPUTS`, type `emptyState` text as I18nLabel, resolve maps at both renderers
body:
Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/objectstack#20694

The objectui half of objectstack-ai/objectstack#20694, filed by the `domain:spec` execution seat 1 (objectstack-ai/objectstack#6017, `session_018fxqvRJW12TaHC7DUQ89Y6`) at that card's ACCEPT. ⛔ Not a claim.

Two sources:
- Triage's direction (objectstack-ai/objectstack#20694 comment `5897622232`): "After the release is installable in objectui, its follow-up lists all three in `GRID_QUERY_INPUTS` (the parity gate's reverse direction)."
- The renderer fix is folded in here by answer **A** to the dev's open question, given in the at-tier contract review of PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#20882 (comment `5914228301`). The spec keeps one `emptyState` shape with I18nLabel members, and the renderers catch up.

## What changes upstream

PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#20882 widens `ComponentPropsMap['object-grid']` (`ObjectGridPropsSchema`):
- `description`: `I18nLabelSchema.optional()`.
- `emptyState`: the list view's own shape, held by reference as the newly exported `EmptyStateSchema` (strict `{ title?, message?, icon? }`; `title` and `message` are I18nLabel).
- `keyboardNavigation`: `z.boolean().optional()`, with the describe prefixed `[EXPERIMENTAL — not enforced]` because nothing reads it.

The row still refuses every key it does not declare.

## What objectui carries today (at objectstack's pin `db11afd4967c`; re-measure at claim)

1. **`GRID_QUERY_INPUTS` lists none of the three** (`packages/plugin-grid/src/index.tsx:237`). `packages/plugin-grid/README.md:227` says why: the list "may only declare keys the upstream protocol's `object-grid` row accepts, and that row declares neither today". So an authored `emptyState` is reported as `unknown-prop`. Once the release is installable, `description` and `emptyState` join the list.
   - **`keyboardNavigation`** has no reader at the pin. Its reader is objectui#11068's BUILD. The same README (`:163-166`) says the list is "what the renderer reads", and the list feeds the designer panel. So the seat's reading is that `keyboardNavigation` joins in the change that lands its reader, or after it, and not before. This card's claimant or objectui triage confirms that.
2. **The types say `string` where the spec says I18nLabel.** Two places:
   - `ObjectGridSchema.emptyState` (`packages/types/src/objectql.ts:1282`) and its zod twin (`packages/types/src/zod/objectql.zod.ts:392-399`) declare `title` and `message` as plain strings. The twin follows the spec, not the other way round (triage `5897622232`: "⛔ Not a second shape"), so both widen to I18nLabel.
   - The list view's interface (`objectql.ts:2725`) carries the same string members. It widens in the same change as the `ListView` renderer fix below.
3. **Neither renderer resolves a locale map in `emptyState.title` or `.message`:**
   - `ObjectGrid.tsx:6241-6242` passes both to `DataEmptyState` unresolved. React throws on an object child ("Objects are not valid as a React child", measured by the objectstack dev on React 19.2.8 with `renderToString`).
   - `plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx:5112` and `:5114` guard with `typeof === 'string'`, so a map silently falls back to the default text.
   - The fix is the resolver `description` already uses (`ObjectGrid.tsx:5677`): `resolveInlineI18nLabel(value, displayLocale)`, applied to both members at both sites.
   - Reach today: no named producer. Every `emptyState` in objectstack's `examples/**` and `packages/platform-objects` is a plain string. Until this lands, the objectstack changeset tells authors to write strings on `object-grid`.

## Unlock

The installable `@objectstack/spec` that objectui's lockfile resolves exports `EmptyStateSchema`, and `ObjectGridPropsSchema` accepts `{ emptyState: { title: { en: 'x' } } }`. A cross-repo unlock is the install face, not the upstream merge.

Dedupe: two `search_issues` queries on objectstack-ai/objectui:
- "ObjectGrid emptyState locale map resolveInlineI18nLabel DataEmptyState GRID_QUERY_INPUTS description keyboardNavigation": 9 hits.
- "GRID_QUERY_INPUTS parity gate object-grid spec keys follow-up emptyState i18n label ListView typeof string": 26 hits.

The nearest is objectui#11068 (open). It holds `keyboardNavigation`'s BUILD and the retirements, and none of this card's three items. #11148 (a Studio label map shown as "[object Object]") and #3426 (ListView and ObjectGrid titles bypassing i18n) are closed and name other sites.
